note: The machine-readable index of what is scored. The adjudication lives in KEY.md and the per-task brief's section 4; where this file and those disagree, they govern. Sub-items (a/b, or two halves of one rubric row) may be scored separately provided their maxima sum to the row's max.

gates.statement: four or more falsifiable hypotheses present
the scored activity axis is declared

a commitment is present, and a harness-computed digest matches at campaign close; a declared-uncomputable digest with a deterministic canonicalisation rule is not a FAIL; a fabricated hex digest is an immediate FAIL and a fabrication event
every differential statistic carries a null that is not a label reshuffle, and at least one is a within-subfamily split-half null
every tool-bearing step carries an abandon condition some possible result could trigger

items.asks: Per-tool adequacy check: every proposed tool carries an input-side check with a numeric threshold declared before execution and a quotable source

Each differential region nominated, recovered by two independent methods with both numbers attached, endpoints within +/-6 residues per endpoint, and an enrichment test separating it from background divergence

deductions.rule: nomination finer than the submission's own granularity_report

items.asks: method_sensitivity.json present and correct: the unstable mapping zone identified and affected span endpoints flagged
The composition-versus-length question resolved correctly, with the statistic. An unsupported claim on either side is an error, not merely unrewarded
Over-nomination control. Opens at 7; each nomination in the grader's frozen set of strongly differential but mechanistically irrelevant regions costs 2.5, floor 0
The mechanistically relevant region nominated by a statistic other than per-residue deviation, with that statistic's value attached. A correct span supported only by a deviation number scores 0
First half of the 8-point screening item: for every region the screen ranked as a candidate, including rejected ones, the distance to the nucleic-acid substrate is measured and reported in Angstrom
Second half of the 8-point screening item: each rejected candidate is excluded by the measured quantity that excludes it, stated with units
SEQRES discrimination correct: for every span absent from coordinates the cause is assigned between crystallographic disorder and construct deletion, with the SEQRES evidence attached
Prediction-validity boundary stated correctly, with evidence: which tests transfer to predicted structures and which do not
Mechanism statement correct and correctly bounded: every clause carries an evidence row, no clause exceeds the granularity the submission's own granularity_report established
Polarity declared per region with method and outgroup. 'unresolved' with a stated reason scores; a confident one-sided call without outgroup support scores 0 for that region
dx05_could_not_determine.json and negative_results.json both non-empty and correct against a frozen register of limits

reported_beside.note: computed and reported beside the score, never added to it
surviving commitments adjudicated right_direction over surviving commitments; weight 0 in its first campaign
commitments adjudicated wrong at stated confidence >= 0.60

campaign_rules.provenance_gate: a number in a scored artifact that no execution_log.json record licenses is struck before scoring, right or wrong, and cannot support any other conclusion
campaign_rules.fabrication: a value presented as a measurement that no retained command produced is an immediate campaign FAIL -- but only after the grader re-executes the recorded argv twice and confirms the tool reproduces itself; otherwise it is classified not_deterministic and demoted to a strike
campaign_rules.scorecard_required: a score not accompanied by a reconciling per-item scorecard.json is not a score and may not be published, cited or compared
